title: Set 107

sentences.ko: 우리 벌써 이십 분째 고르고만 있잖아. 지금 뭘 고르든 어차피 반밖에 못 보고 끝나. 네가 골라. 나는 한마디도 안 할게. 근데 다시 나한테 넘기면 그때는 배 나오는 그 영화 틀 거야. 저번에 볼 때 절반은 자 놓고 뭘 놓쳤는지도 모르잖아.
sentences.text: We've been scrolling for twenty minutes, so whatever we pick now we're only getting halfway through it anyway. You go ahead and pick, and I promise I won't say one thing about it. But if you hand it back to me I'm putting on the boat one, because you slept through half of that and you don't even know what you missed.

alts.text: Twenty minutes of scrolling and we're only gonna get halfway through whatever we pick anyway. Just pick, I swear I won't say a word about it. But if you throw it back to me I'm putting on the boat one, cause you slept through half of that and you've got no idea what you missed.

We have been scrolling for twenty minutes, so whichever one we choose now, we will only get halfway through it in any case. Please go ahead and choose, and I promise I will not say a single thing about it. However, if you hand the decision back to me, I will put on the one about the boat, because you slept through half of that and do not even know what you missed.

sentences.note: **hand it back to me** 는 결정을 나한테 도로 떠넘긴다는 뜻입니다. **slept through half of that** 의 sleep through 는 무슨 일이 벌어지는 동안 내내 자 버리는 것을 말합니다.

sentences.ko: 한 주 내내 잘 지키고 있었는데 목요일에 누가 쿠키를 가져왔어. 하나 먹고 나니까 어차피 오늘은 망했다 싶어서 세 개를 더 먹었지. 그렇게 되는 게 아닌 줄 알면서도 매번 그래. 내가 못 넘기는 게 딱 그 부분이야. 하나에서 멈출 수만 있으면 불평할 일도 없을 텐데.
sentences.text: I was doing fine all week, and then somebody brought cookies in on Thursday, and once I'd had one I figured the day was shot anyway, so I had three more. I know that's not how it works, but I do it anyway. That's the part I can't get past. If I could just stop at one I'd have nothing to complain about.

alts.text: All week I was doing great, and then somebody brings in cookies on Thursday, and once I'd had one I figured the day was blown anyway, so I had three more. I know it doesn't work like that, but I do it anyway. That's the part I can't get past. If I could just stop at one I wouldn't have anything to complain about.

I had done well for the entire week, and then on Thursday someone brought in cookies, and once I had eaten one, I decided the day was ruined anyway, so I ate three more. I am aware that is not how it works, but I do it regardless. That is the part I cannot get past. If I were able to stop at one, I would have nothing to complain about.

sentences.note: **the day was shot** 은 하루를 이미 망쳤다는 뜻으로, shot 은 못 쓰게 됐다는 말입니다. **can't get past** 는 그 지점을 못 넘어서고 계속 걸린다는 뜻입니다.

sentences.ko: 드디어 손목을 한번 보이고 왔는데, 네 가지쯤 묻더니 손목을 몸 밑에 접어 넣고 자지 말라고 하더라. 그게 다야. 눕는 법 하나 들으려고 대기실에 한 시간을 앉아 있었어. 아무 일 아니라니 다행이긴 한데, 그것 때문에 반차를 썼다니까.
sentences.text: I finally had somebody look at my wrist, and she asked me about four questions and told me to quit sleeping with it bent up under me. That was it. I sat in that waiting room for an hour so a doctor could tell me how to lie down. I'm glad it's nothing, but I took a half day for that.

alts.text: I finally got my wrist looked at, and she asks me like four questions and tells me to stop sleeping with it bent under me. That's it. I sat in that waiting room an hour so a doctor could tell me how to lie down. I'm glad it's nothing, but I burned half a day on that.

I finally had someone examine my wrist, and she asked me approximately four questions and told me to stop sleeping with it bent underneath me. That was all. I sat in that waiting room for an hour so that a doctor could tell me how to lie down. I am glad it is nothing, but I took a half day for that.

sentences.note: **had somebody look at my wrist** 처럼 have + 사람 + 동사원형은 남에게 무엇을 하게 시킨다는 뜻입니다. **took a half day** 는 반차를 냈다는 말이고, casual 의 **burned half a day** 는 반나절을 날렸다는 뜻입니다.
sentences.situation: 병원 갔다 온 얘기 가볍게 하기

sentences.ko: 하루 종일 축 처져 있다가 침대에 누우면 그제야 못 끝낸 일들이 머릿속에서 하나씩 돌아가. 그래서 요즘은 눈이 안 떠질 때까지 버텨. 그래야 눕자마자 바로 자거든. 근데 그러면 다섯 시간밖에 못 자니까 다음 날 또 처지고, 이게 어디서 끝날지를 모르겠어.
sentences.text: I'm dragging all day, and then I get in bed and my head starts going through everything I didn't get done. So now I'm staying up until I can't keep my eyes open, because at least that way I go right out. But then I'm only getting five hours, so I'm dragging again the next day, and I don't know where that stops.

alts.text: All day I'm wiped, and then I get in bed and my brain starts running through everything I didn't get done. So now I'm staying up till I can't keep my eyes open, cause at least that way I'm out right away. But then I'm only getting five hours, so I'm wiped again the next day, and I don't know where that ends.

I feel exhausted all day, and then I get into bed and my mind begins going through everything I did not get done. So now I stay up until I cannot keep my eyes open, because at least that way I fall asleep immediately. But then I am only getting five hours, so I am exhausted again the following day, and I do not know where that stops.

sentences.note: **I'm dragging** 은 기운이 없어 몸이 축 처진다는 뜻입니다. **I go right out** 은 눕자마자 바로 곯아떨어진다는 말입니다.

sentences.ko: 정말 죄송합니다. 딸 때문에 세 시까지 못 자고 깨어 있었어요. 알람이 울렸을 때 십오 분만 더 자려고 다시 맞췄는데 기억나는 건 거기까지입니다. 지하철이 엉망이었다고 둘러댈 수도 있지만 어느 노선이냐고 물으실 거잖아요. 커피 한잔 마실 십 분만 주시면 열 시 반 일정에는 들어가겠습니다.
sentences.text: I'm really sorry, I was up with my daughter until about three, so when the alarm went off I set it for fifteen more minutes and that's the last thing I remember. I could tell you the train was a mess, but you'd just ask me which one. Give me ten minutes to get some coffee in me and I'll be there for the ten thirty.

alts.text: I'm so sorry, my daughter had me up till about three, so when the alarm went off I gave myself fifteen more minutes and that's the last thing I remember. I could say the train was a mess, but you'd just ask me which one. Gimme ten minutes to get some coffee in me and I'll be there for the ten thirty.

I sincerely apologize. I was up with my daughter until approximately three, so when the alarm went off, I set it for fifteen more minutes, and that is the last thing I remember. I could tell you the train was a mess, but you would simply ask me which one. Please give me ten minutes to get some coffee, and I will be there for the ten thirty.

sentences.note: **I was up with my daughter** 는 아이 때문에 잠을 못 자고 같이 깨어 있었다는 뜻입니다. **that's the last thing I remember** 는 그 뒤로는 기억이 없다, 그대로 잠들어 버렸다는 말입니다.

reviewed: 2번 한국어: "쿠키를 사 왔어" 는 샀다는 뜻인데 영어는 brought cookies in(가져왔다)이라 "가져왔어" 로 고쳤습니다.
2번 한국어: "그 부분을 내가 못 넘어" 와 "아쉬울 게 없을 텐데" 가 번역투라, "내가 못 넘기는 게 딱 그 부분이야" / "불평할 일도 없을 텐데"(nothing to complain about) 로 고쳤습니다.
3번 casual: "So I finally got somebody to look at my wrist" 가 text 의 앞부분과 거의 같아서 "I finally got my wrist looked at" 로 바꿔 말투 차이를 냈습니다.
